issue_request: FHIR-5942 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested renaming ValueSet.stableDate to ValueSet.lockedDate, with descriptions updated to use VSD Locked Date terminology rather than stability/static/dynamic terminology that could be confused with value set binding concepts.
initial_application: The main resource change was applied in git-svn commit 29e0f369d9 (#5942 - ValueSet: rename "stableDate" to "lockedDate"). Current active ValueSet source already defines ValueSet.compose.lockedDate and no longer contains ValueSet.stableDate. A later version-management documentation reorganization left active narrative wording that still referred to a "stable date" and "StableDates".
additional_context: Later published ValueSet issues refined lockedDate semantics and wording, including FHIR-5982's context-dependent interpretation and FHIR-18702's VSD-aligned definition. A later FHIR-55478 proposal to deprecate lockedDate is only Triaged and was not treated as a final decision. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant community evidence that would change the Jira/source/git conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/versions.html so the value set/code system versioning policy refers to a linked locked date and to locked dates, while leaving the historical source/history.html release note that explicitly says stableDate was renamed to lockedDate.

source/versions.html: replaced "StableDates" with "Locked dates" in the non-immutable value set versioning policy.
